questions.question: Pick out the wrongly spelt word from the given words.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Saspence.'

Key Points

  • Let us explore the options:-
    • 'Saspence': There is no such word in English or we can say that there is some spelling mistake in this word.

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

  • Example of 'Suspense' in a sentence:

questions.question: Select the correctly spelt word to fill in the blank. Helium is used with oxygen for asthma treatment because it __________ very easily.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the correctly spelt word to fill in the blank.

Helium is used with oxygen for asthma treatment because it __________ very easily.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'diffuses'.
 
Key Points
  • The word "diffuses" means to spread or cause to spread over a wide area or among a large number of people.
  • Helium is used with oxygen for asthma treatment because it diffuses very easily.
  • The other options: "diffusez," "difuses," and "diffuzes" are not correctly spelled.

​Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 3'.

Complete Sentence: Helium is used with oxygen for asthma treatment because it diffuses very easily.

Additional Information
  • Diffusez: Incorrect spelling, does not convey the intended meaning.
  • Difuses: Incorrect spelling, should be "diffuses".
  • Diffuzes: Incorrect spelling, does not convey the intended meaning.

questions.question: Directions: Select the incorrectly spelt word.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'irepairable'.

Key Points

  • Let us explore the options:-
    • 'Irepairable': There is no such word in English or we can say that there is some spelling mistake in this word.
      • The correct spelling is 'Irreparable' means something that cannot be repaired. (जिस क्षति की पूर्ति न हो सके, जिस स्थिति को सुधारा न जा सके; असुधार्य)​
    • 'Illegible' means difficult or impossible to read. (जिसे पढ़ना कठिन या असंभव हो; अपाठ्‌य, दुर्वाच्य)
      • Example: Her signature is totally illegible.
    • 'Irresistible' means too attractive and tempting to be resisted. (अत्‍यंत आकर्षक)
      • Example: The smell of the cake was irresistible.
    • 'Illegitimate' means not allowed by law; against the rules. (गै़र-क़ानूनी, अवैध; नियमों के विरुद्घ)
      • Example: They were fired from their jobs for illegitimate reasons.
         

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Additional Information

  • Example of 'Irreparable' in a sentence:
    • The flood did irreparable damage to the building.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option that can rectify the incorrectly spelt word in the following sentence. I doubt that these lifts can accomodate 100 people.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option that can rectify the incorrectly spelt word in the following sentence.
I doubt that these lifts can accomodate 100 people.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 4' i.e. 'accommodate'.

Key Points

  • The word "accommodate" means to provide space or room for someone or something; to adjust to someone's needs or requirements. (समायोजित करना)
    • Example: The hotel can accommodate up to 500 guests.
  • "accomodate" is an incorrect spelling and does not carry any specific meaning. (गलत वर्तनी)
    • Example: This room can accomodate all the guests. (Incorrect spelling)
  • Hence, we can infer that the correct spelling is 'accommodate'.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. 'accommodate'.

Additional Information

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

  • acomodate (गलत वर्तनी): Incorrect spelling of 'accommodate'.
    • Example: This room can acomodate all the guests. (Incorrect spelling)
  • accommodatte (गलत वर्तनी): Incorrect spelling of 'accommodate'.
    • Example: The hall can accommodatte a large number of people. (Incorrect spelling)
  • accomondate (गलत वर्तनी): Incorrect spelling of 'accommodate'.
    • Example: The venue can accomondate all the participants. (Incorrect spelling)
